blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
A common approach to measuring bias in Large Language Models is to compare the log-likelihoods of two contrastive stereotype sentences. We argue that such single-pair comparisons are often unreliable: simply rewriting the same stereotype with an alternative attribute can yield
logically inconsistent preferences.
To address this, we propose a dual minimal pair setup that introduces
two axes of comparison for robust stereotype evaluation.
First,
we present a data-augmentation framework
that fills critical gaps
in existing stereotype datasets by generating paraphrases and alternate attributes.
We apply our framework on a set of English, Russian, Spanish and Chinese stereotypes.
Second, we introduce
two evaluation metrics tailored to the dual minimal pair setup .
One of these metrics provides a new
perspective
on bias
by modeling the mutual information (MI) between social groups and stereotyped attributes.
This MI-based
metric is better suited for aggregation and enables more robust comparisons of stereotype strength across different languages and models. Our code is available at https://github.com/stepanat/missing-minimal-pair/ .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Stereotypes express biases by making broad generalizations that associate a group (e.g., boys ) with an attribute (e.g., good at math ). A common approach for evaluating this bias in Large Language Models (LLMs) is to examine the log-likelihood of
contrastive sentences ( Mitchell et al., 2025 ; Rowe et al., 2025 ) : the stereotype (e.g., Boys are good at math ) versus the same association expressed about an alternate group (e.g., Girls are good at math ).
However,
making inferences about
LLM biases from single-pair
comparisons
of sentences
raises theoretical concerns, as alternative comparisons are critical for judgments on generalizations ( Hoorens et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose a new paradigm for evaluating stereotype bias in LLMs consisting of a dual minimal pair setup (i.e., two sentence pairs) and a new evaluation metric for this setup.
We argue that stereotype evaluation frameworks must consider a full contrastive set of two sentence pairs.
The first pair
contrasts
the stereotyped group with an alternate group ( boys vs. girls ) in terms of their association with the stereotyped attribute.
The second pair
contrasts the same groups but in terms of their association with an alternate attribute ( good at math → \rightarrow bad at math ).
An accurate metric must consider the difference in both pairs , as drawing inferences from either pair in isolation can result in semantically contradictory expressions of bias (e.g., associating Boys with both good at math and bad at math ; see Figure 1 ).
Additionally, we note that the same underlying bias can be expressed in different surface forms (consider Boys are good at math and Boys excel in mathematics ).

blocks.en:
Existing datasets do not capture alternate attributes and often lack diversity in how a single stereotype is expressed.
Therefore,
we propose a data-augmentation framework (which relies on LLM prompting and careful automatic quality measures) to expand a set of stereotypes to include both paraphrases and alternate attributes.
We run our framework in a multilingual setting on stereotypes from the BiasShades dataset ( Mitchell et al., 2025 ) , covering English, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese (with an average of 176 stereotypes per language).

因此,
我们提出一个数据增强框架(它依赖于LLM的提示和谨慎的自动质量措施),以扩大一套陈规定型,既包括解释,也包括其他属性。
我们的框架以多种语言为背景,从BiasShades数据集(Mitchell等,2025年)开始,涵盖英文、西班牙文、俄文和中文(每种语言平均176个定型观念)。

blocks.en:
To evaluate bias under our new paradigm, we propose two metrics.
Our first metric is a natural extension of existing log-probability approaches to account for alternate attributes – it is signed (preserving directionality), making it useful for probing individual stereotypes.
Our second metric repackages the log-probability signal using mutual information (MI) and represents the magnitude of association between groups and binary attributes, which makes it aggregation-friendly and suitable for fair comparison of models and languages.
blocks.zh:
为了评估在我们的新模式下的偏见,我们提出了两个衡量标准。
我们的第一个衡量标准是将现有的日志概率方法自然地延伸,以解释替代属性 — — 它被签名(保留方向性),使其对检验个人定型观念有用。
我们的第二个指标是使用相互信息(MI)重新包装日志概率信号,并代表各组和二进制属性之间的关联程度,这使得它便于汇总,适合公平比较模型和语言.

blocks.en:
We then use our metrics to evaluate nine LLM configurations covering five model families and multiple model sizes.
First, we show that ignoring alternate attributes when evaluating stereotypes can lead to contradictory biases. On 17-30% of stereotypes in BiasShades, we found that LLMs preferred both an attribute and its alternate for the same group.
To validate our alternate-attribute-aware metrics, we then show that our proposed metrics
accurately capture semantic associations between groups and attributes using a dataset of conceptual norms ( McRae et al., 2005 ) . Furthermore, we show that both metrics capture the same underlying bias signal.
Finally, we use our augmented data to examine aggregate bias across languages and models.

最后,我们利用我们增加的数据来审查各种语言和模式的汇总偏差。

blocks.en: In summary, in this paper: 1. We demonstrate the necessity of incorporating alternate attributes into stereotype evaluation frameworks by showing that the problem persists at scale across languages and models. 2. We provide a framework for augmenting existing stereotypes with paraphrases and alternates, applying it in a multilingual setting. 3. We show how to incorporate alternate attributes into log-probability metrics with two concrete proposals. 4. We demonstrate the usefulness of our MI metric in comparing bias across languages on our augmented stereotype sets.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en:
Stereotypes are often expressed as generalizing statements, connecting a social group to an exhibited attribute ( Davani et al., 2024 ) .
Recent work has emphasized the importance of alternative attributes in explaining the validity of generalizations ( Hoorens et al., 2026 ; Hermans et al., 2026 ) as well as in constructing large-scale datasets ( Allaway et al., 2024 ) .
These insights are useful in NLP: for example, Mun et al. (2023) compare the effectiveness of using alternate groups vs. alternate qualities as counter-speech strategies.
blocks.zh:
定型观念往往被表述为概括性言论,将一个社会群体与展示的属性联系起来(Davani等人,2024年)。
最近的工作强调了替代属性在解释通论有效性(Hoorens等,2026;Hermans等,2026)以及构建大型数据集(Allaway等,2024)方面的重要性.
这些见解在NLP中很有用:例如:Mun等. (2023)比较使用备用组与备用特质作为反言论策略的效果.

blocks.en:
Using two axes of comparison for probing at bias is grounded in findings from social psychology.
Early research in NLP was inspired by the IAT ( Caliskan and Lewis, 2020 ; Greenwald et al., 1998 ) , which measured the association between two pairs of concepts and attributes (e.g., flower-insect and pleasant-unpleasant).
Approaches using word embeddings ( Caliskan et al., 2017 , e.g., WEAT, see) analogously required two dimensions of comparison.
Surprisingly, many recent works have lost the second axis and focused only on creating a contrast for the social group ( Nangia et al., 2020 ; Rowe et al., 2025 ; Mitchell et al., 2025 ) .
There are exceptions: Nadeem et al. (2021) emphasize the importance of stereotype and counter-stereotype pairs.
Similarly, both Bai et al. (2025) and Farahani et al. (2026) operate on semantic axes with clear alternate poles.
However, these latter methods are not applicable to likelihood-based evaluations, which remain a popular paradigm.
blocks.zh:
利用两个比较轴来探究偏见,是基于社会心理学的结论。
NLP的早期研究由IAT(Caliskan and Lewis,2020;Greenwald等,1998.)所启发,它测量了两对概念和属性(如花虫和令人愉快-不愉快)之间的联系.
使用词嵌入法(Caliskan等人,2017年,如WEAT,见)类似地需要两个维度的比较.
令人惊讶的是,最近许多作品失去了第二轴,只专注于为社会群体创造一个对比(Nangia等,2020年;Rowe等,2025年;Mitchell等,2025年)。
有例外: Nadeem等 (2021)强调定型和反定型对子的重要性.
同样地,Bai等人(2025年)和Farahani等人(2026年)在语义轴上运行,有明显的相交杆.
然而,这些后一种方法并不适用于基于可能性的评价,这仍然是一个受欢迎的范例。

blocks.en:
We define an alternate attribute as the semantic opposite of the original stereotyped attribute.
Prior literature discusses what makes a good counter-stereotype ( Fraser et al., 2021 ; Fraser et al., 2023 ; Shejole and Bhattacharyya, 2025 ; Shejole and Bhattacharyya, 2026 ) .
We do not claim that an alternate attribute necessarily performs the same function as a counter-stereotype.
We use alternate attributes to disentangle general preference for a group from a specific connection between the group and attribute, similarly to how Parrish et al. (2022) use negative and non-negative questions in their BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for QA).
blocks.zh:
我们把替代属性定义为与原定型属性相反的语义.
先前的文献讨论了什么是好的反定型(Fraser等,2021;Fraser等,2023;Shejole和Bhattacharyya,2025;Shejole和Bhattacharyya,2026).
我们并不声称替代属性必然履行与反定型相同的功能.
我们使用替代属性来区分一个群体在群体与属性之间特定联系上的一般偏好,类似于Parrish等人(2022年)如何在其BBQ数据集中使用负面和非负面问题(Bias Basic for QA).

blocks.en:
Automatically augmenting stereotype datasets can be useful: for example, Park et al. (2024) use ChatGPT to generate stereotype-free sentences from the Social Bias Inference Corpus ( Sap et al., 2020 ) for a contrastive learning framework.
When generating alternates, a special point of consideration is to not simply negate the original, wherever possible, because negation is a problem with language models Anschütz et al. (2023) ; Truong et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Lunardi et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
自动增强定型数据集可能是有用的:例如, Park等人(2024年)使用ChatGPT从"社会比斯推论"(Sap等,2020年)中生成无定型观念的句子,作为对比性的学习框架.
在产生副词时,一个特殊的考虑点不是简单地否定原词,只要有可能,因为否定是语言模型Anschütz等人(2023年);Truong等人(2025年);Wang等人(2025年);Lunardi等人(2025年)的一个问题。

blocks.en:
Paraphrasing has been used to enhance stereotype datasets ( Kazi et al., 2025 ; Fattahi et al., 2024 ) , usually in the context of data-augmentation for fine-tuning.
However, log-probability based approaches often don’t explicitly include paraphrasing in their evaluation design, despite LLMs not always being robust to surface-level linguistic changes ( Lunardi et al., 2025 ) .
This leaves a critical gap, as quantifying bias on a single minimal pair is brittle.
We provide a stereotype augmentation framework that combines both paraphrasing and alternates generation in a multilingual setting.
blocks.zh:
参数化被用于加强定型观念数据集(Kazi等人,2025年;Fattahi等人,2024年),通常用于微调数据。
然而,基于日志概率的方法往往没有明确在其评价设计中包括解释性,尽管LLMs并不总是能对地表语言变化起到强有力的作用(Lunardi等人,2025年)。
这就留下了关键的缺口,因为对一对最小的一对进行量化的偏差是微弱的。
我们提供了一个陈规定型的增强框架,将代词和代词结合到多语种环境中。

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of metrics for bias evaluation with log-probabilities. B G B_{\mathrm{G}} collectively refers to prior works which use a single contrastive sentence pair ( Mitchell et al., 2025 ; Rowe et al., 2025 ) ; B G × A B_{\mathrm{G\times A}} (ours) adds an alternate-attribute contrast; I G × A I_{\mathrm{G\times A}} (ours) recasts the log-probability signal as mutual information. Both B G × A B_{\mathrm{G\times A}} and I G × A I_{\mathrm{G\times A}} are moderately robust to paraphrasing.

Early stereotype studies explored variations on taking the difference of likelihoods between a stereotypical sentence and a single contrastive sentence as an indicator of model bias ( Nangia et al., 2020 ; Nadeem et al., 2021 ) .
While some works suggest that logits may not always align with the model’s text output ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , log-probabilities have been shown to be
more effective than explicit prompting for assessing an LM’s implicit simple world knowledge ( Kauf et al., 2024 ) .
Similarly, Cilleruelo et al. (2025) observe human stereotypical biases when using log-probabilities to study generics.
The log-probability paradigm for bias evaluation thus remains as a prominent framework in recent LLM work ( Mitchell et al., 2025 ; Rowe et al., 2025 ) .
We show how to repackage log-probability signals through mutual information, which yields a robust measure of stereotypical associations suitable for aggregation (see Table 1 ).

blocks.en: 3.3 Automatic quality filtering

blocks.en:
We use automated filters to ensure quality of generated text.
We first use a syntax and grammar checker 1 1 1 https://pypi.org/project/language_tool_python/ to filter out poor generations.
We then use semantic and Natural Language Inference (NLI) filters to filter out poor paraphrases and alternates.

然后,我们使用语义和自然语言推论(NLI)过滤器来过滤差的句子和替代.

blocks.en:

and keep only paraphrases that have cosine similarity of at least 0.7 0.7 with their original stereotype. 2 2 2 All thresholds are chosen after inspecting the data. We also use
a multilingual NLI model 3 3 3 joeddav/xlm-roberta-large-xnli to compute the probability that the paraphrase contradicts the stereotype, and vice versa.

blocks.en:
We apply our framework to the BiasShades dataset ( Mitchell et al., 2025 ) , a multilingual templated dataset with human annotations of stereotype validity across languages and regions.
It consists of 304 stereotypes translated across 16 languages, where each stereotype consists of a template and instantiations with different social groups.
We focus on four languages spanning diverse linguistic and cultural spaces: English ( en ), Russian ( ru ), Spanish ( es ), Chinese ( zh ).
This allows us to compare metrics across vastly different tokenizing strategies for Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese.

blocks.en:
We ran a human annotation study
to validate the quality of our data-augmentation framework.
We sample 90 (stereotype, paraphrase) and 90 (attribute, alternate-attribute) pairs and recruit native speaker volunteers to check these in each target language.
With each set of positive examples, we manually construct 10 negative examples as attention checks (e.g., a stereotype paired with a different stereotype’s paraphrase instead of its own).
Across languages, 91.2 91.2 - 97.5 % 97.5\% of paraphrases and 93.8 93.8 - 97.5 97.5 % of alternate attributes are accepted by the human annotators.
Considering that judging paraphrases (especially in the context of stereotypes) is a difficult task, these results indicate the high quality of our data-augmentation
framework in a multilingual setting.

blocks.en: 4.3 Metric validation with semantic norms
blocks.zh: 4.3 语义规范的计量验证

blocks.en:
We demonstrate that in a minimal pair setup with alternate attributes, our log-probability based metrics B G × A B_{\mathrm{G\times A}} and I G × A I_{\mathrm{G\times A}} are a good indicator of an LLM’s underlying semantic association between groups and attributes.
Stereotypes form an association between a group and an attribute.
But, it is difficult (if not impossible) to get a "gold label" to anchor the expected strength of that association.
We turn to the McRae norms, a well-known set of concepts annotated with feature norms ( McRae et al., 2005 ) , because they capture the same idea: they form a semantic association between concepts (e.g., airplane ) and features (e.g. large , can fly ).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
By emphasizing alternate attributes and diverse linguistic paraphrases in paradigms of stereotype evaluation, we ensure that the signal captured at the individual instance level is robust.
This enables
cross-lingual and cross-model analysis, because robust local metrics can be confidently aggregated.
We found that input language significantly affects stereotype strength (as measured through log-probability metrics).
At the same time, the magnitude and statistical significance of the differences depends largely on the exact stereotype being assessed.
We observed no sweeping patterns suggesting that instruction-tuned models are universally less biased, nor did we find that specific model families are consistently less biased in specific languages.
blocks.zh:
通过在陈规定型评价范式中强调不同的属性和不同的语言解释,我们确保单个实例一级所捕捉到的信号是强有力的。
这样可以
跨语言和跨模型分析,因为强健的本地度量衡可以有把握地汇总.
我们发现,输入语言大大地影响了定型观念的强度(通过日志概率度量衡量)。
同时,这些差异的程度和统计意义在很大程度上取决于正在评估的确切定型观念。
我们没有看到任何全面模式表明,经过教育调整的模式普遍较少有偏见,也没有发现具体模式家庭在具体语言方面一贯较少有偏见。

blocks.en:
Our framework and metrics can be useful tools for easily diagnosing a model’s
associations between concepts (e.g., groups and attributes)
since log-probability-based approaches are quick to compute. This
allows for frequent evaluation during a training life-cycle.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架和衡量标准可以成为方便诊断模型的有用工具
概念之间的关联(如群体和属性)
由于基于对数概率的方法可以快速计算。 这个
允许在培训周期内经常进行评价。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Stereotypes are often expressed as
generalizations
associating a group with an attribute.
To measure stereotype biases, we demonstrated that log-probability differences are not reliable when alternate attributes are ignored.
As a result, we argued
for the necessity of constructing minimal pairs for stereotypes
that not only contrast groups but also attributes.
We first proposed a data augmentation framework that can expand a starting set of stereotypes to our proposed dual minimal pair setup, and we applied it to a set of English, Spanish, Russian and Chinese stereotypes from the BiasShades dataset.
Then, we proposed two metrics, from which we recommend I G × A I_{\mathrm{G\times A}} for analyses of stereotypes across models and tokenizers, as we have shown it to be a bounded, theoretically grounded measure of group-attribute dependence.
On the individual stereotype level, B G × A B_{\mathrm{G\times A}} might be a better choice due to retaining directionality of preference.
blocks.zh:
定型观念往往表现为:
概括
将群体与属性联系起来。
为了衡量陈规定型偏见,我们表明,在忽略其他属性时,日志概率差异是不可靠的。
因此,我们争论
* 有必要为定型观念建造最低限度的配对
不仅是对照组,还有属性。
我们首先提出了一个数据增强框架,可以将一套起步的陈规定型观念扩展至我们提议的双重最小组合,我们把它应用于比亚斯沙德数据集的一套英文、西班牙文、俄文和中文陈规定型观念。
然后,我们提出了两个衡量标准,我们从中推荐I G × A I + mathrm{G\times A}用于分析模型和标注器的陈规定型观念,因为我们已经证明这是一个有限度的、理论上基于群体属性依赖性的衡量标准。
在个人的定型观念层面,由于保留偏好的方向性,B G × A BQQMThrm{G\times A}可能是一个更好的选择。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Generating valid paraphrases is a hard task.
First of all, with LLM-based data augmentation, there are inherent differences in generation across different languages.
In the context of bias, the task becomes even harder, as what makes a “stereotype" different from any other generalization is highly dependent on cultural context.
There will never be perfect human alignment on judging paraphrases that reflect the same stereotype vs. deviate from the association.
We show that our paraphrase generation framework works well to serve the purpose of generating diverse linguistic expressions of a similar underlying thought but there is future scope for improving standards for stereotype paraphrase generation.
blocks.zh:
生成有效的参数是一个艰巨的任务 。
首先,随着基于LLM的数据增强,不同语言的生成存在固有的差异.
在偏见的背景下,这项任务变得更加艰巨,因为使一种“陈规定型”有别于任何其他通俗化的方法高度依赖于文化背景。
在判断那些反映同样定型观念和偏离协会的诠释时,永远不会有完美的人类结合。
我们显示,我们的译名生成框架能够很好地实现产生类似基本思想的各种语言表达方式的目的,但今后仍有改进定型译名生成标准的余地。

blocks.en:
Some ways of expressing bias are very idiomatic, which makes it hard to evaluate semantic similarity with traditional NLP methods and to generate an appropriate alternate attribute.
For example, initially for the stereotype: Blondes are dumb an LLM generated the paraphrase Blondes aren’t the sharpest tools in the shed .
NLI models struggle to correctly judge this pair because they are often too literal.
While LLM-based filtering is possible, it makes scaling to many languages challenging and likely requires substantial prompt tuning.
blocks.zh:
一些表达偏差的方法非常平庸,这使得难以评价与传统NLP方法的语义相似性并产生适当的替代属性.
例如,最初的定型观念是: Blondes很笨, LLM 生成了比喻,
NLI模型很难正确判断这对,因为它们往往过于文字化.
虽然基于LLM的过滤是可能的,但它使得缩放到许多语言具有挑战性,可能需要大量的即时调试.

blocks.en:
Our work focused on four languages, and future work should expand to more diverse linguistic and cultural spaces.
We also focused only on stereotypes with the form '[GROUP] [ATTRIBUTE]' .
This works for languages with Subject-Verb-Object (SVO) or SOV word order, but not for VSO (e.g., Arabic) or VOS (e.g., Fijian).
We frame stereotypical attributes as a Bernoulli random variable, which is a good starting point as it builds off of prior work in generalizations and linguistics.
Future work should expand to alternative theoretical formalizations.
Finally, future work could focus on evaluating the metrics in their usefulness in downstream tasks, given that there are inherent limitations of using minimal pairs for NLP tasks (despite them being a popular paradigm, see more in Vamvas and Sennrich (2021) ).
For example, future work could look for a correlation between this metric and counter-speech generation.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作侧重于四种语言,今后的工作应扩大到更多样化的语言和文化空间。
我们还只关注“[GROUP][ATTRIBUTE]”形式的定型观念。
这适用于主题-Verb-object(SVO)或SOV单词顺序的语言,但不适用于VSO(如阿拉伯语)或VOS(如斐济语).
我们把陈规定型的属性设定为伯努利随机变量,这是一个良好的起点,因为它建立在通论和语言学的以往工作的基础上。
今后的工作应扩大到备选的理论形式化。
最后,今后的工作可以侧重于评估衡量标准在下游任务中的有用性,因为NLP任务使用最小对有内在的局限性(尽管它们是受欢迎的范例,更多见Vamvas和Sennrich (2021年))。
例如,未来的工作可以寻找这种度量法和反相声的生成之间的关联.

blocks.en: 8 Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 8 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Stereotype and bias evaluation is a sensitive domain.
We fully acknowledge that augmenting an existing stereotype dataset with more examples, including paraphrases and alternate attributes, risks further propagating bias by expressing it in new linguistic forms.
However, we also believe that there is still a lot of work to be done in developing accurate and robust metrics for enabling safer downstream models.
To this end, we believe that our work does more good than harm.
Additionally, we will mitigate any potential adverse effects of our work by publishing the augmented data with the appropriate licensing (see Appendix I.1 ).
blocks.zh:
定型和偏见评价是一个敏感的领域.
我们完全承认,用更多的例子,包括解释和替代属性,增加现有定型观念数据集,有可能通过以新的语言形式表达偏见而进一步传播偏见。
然而,我们也认为,在制定准确而有力的衡量标准,使下游模式更加安全方面,仍有许多工作要做。
为此,我们认为我们的工作比伤害更有益。
此外,我们将通过公布附有适当许可证的扩充数据来减轻我们工作可能产生的任何不利影响(见附录一.1)。

We recruited native speakers
for each of our 4 target languages to verify the quality of the automatically generated data.
Each volunteer annotator was fully informed about the purposes of the validation and consented to participate.
They completed two tasks: verifying alternates and paraphrases.
Each task consisted of judging 100 pairs of sentences on their semantic relationship and noting any cases of disfluencies or grammatical errors.
Across both tasks, annotators therefore judged a total of 200 pairs of sentences, which took no more than 1 hour.

blocks.en: C.2 Results
blocks.zh: C.2 结果

blocks.en:
Results from the human validation are in Table 6 .
Across all languages and for both tasks, the True Positive acceptance rate is above 90%, exceeding 95% for English and Chinese.
Judging paraphrases and semantic opposites is hard, therefore the strong performance across the board reveals that both the LLM generation pipeline and the automated filters result in high quality final data.
The True Negatives reject rate is consistently low, revealing that the automated filtering thresholds could be conservative - in our case, we prefer high precision of high quality data rather than maximal recall, since we on average end up with 9 paraphrases per stereotype.
Validators almost perfectly reject all mismatched samples, except for the occasional case where random shuffling of attributes across stereotypes resulted in a sensical combination.
It is inevitable to end up with fluency errors when using LLMs for data augmentation, and we tried to filter out problematic examples using language_tool_python.LanguageTool .
The resulting disfluency rates are ≤ 5 % \leq 5\% , except for an 8.75% (7/80 TP examples) for the Russian paraphrasing task, which we consider separately.
blocks.zh:
人类验证的结果见表6。
在所有语言和两种任务中,真实的正接受率超过90%,英语和汉语的接受率超过95%。
判别出句子和语义对立是很难的,因此,全面的强性能表明,LLM生成管和自动化滤波器都产生了高质量的最终数据.
真实负值拒绝率一直很低,这表明自动过滤阈值可能是保守的 -- -- 就我们而言,我们更倾向于高精度的高质量数据,而不是最大限度的召回,因为我们平均每个定型观念都有9个句子。
验证者几乎完全拒绝所有不匹配的样本,只是偶尔出现的情况,即各种陈规定型的属性随意分散导致理智的结合。
在使用 LLMs 进行数据增强时, 不可避免地会出现流利性错误, 我们试图用语言_tool_python. LanguageTool 过滤出有问题的例子 。

blocks.en:
After looking into the source of the Russian paraphrasing errors and validating with a second native speaker, we believe that at least 3 of the marked dislfuencies are edge grammar cases, as they concern the usage of "–".
Specifically, the validator marked " Спящие дети – милые " ( Sleeping kids are cute ) as containing an extra "–", even though this exact formulation is the way the stereotype is provided in the original BiasShades data.
The validator had the same comment for " Восточные немцы — безработные " ( East Germans are unemployed ) and " Место мужчины – на кухне " ( A man’s place is in the kitchen ), both equally direct original stereotypes taken from BiasShades exactly as they are written.
The annotator also commented that the paraphrase " Место мужчины — это приготовление еды на кухне " ( A man’s place is preparing food in the kitchen ) is incorrect.
After checking with a second native speaker, we believe these can be considered debatable corner cases rather than true critical disfluencies, as the usage of "-" depends on author style and intended pragmatic intent.
For the last example, the second native speaker’s opinion was that while it sounds clumsy and unnatural, they do not consider it ungrammatical.
As such, 8.75% represents a ceiling on the true rate of critical disfluencies - if we eliminate the 3 examples the rate becomes 5% - hence the Russian data is still of acceptable quality.
blocks.zh:
在调查了俄语解释错误的来源并以第二位母语进行验证后,我们认为,至少有3起明显的分歧是边缘语法案例,因为它们涉及“-”的使用。
具体来说,验证器标有"QQ – – (睡觉的孩子很可爱)",包含一个额外的"–",尽管这种确切的表述方式是原始的BiasShades数据中提供的定型.
鉴定人对 " Восточные -- -- (东德失业) " 和 " -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- " (一个人的位置在厨房)有同样的评论,两者都是同样直接的原创定型观念,完全照写。
注释员还评论说, " Место -- -- это -- -- " (一个人在厨房准备食物)这一短语是不正确的。
在询问第二位本地人后,我们认为这些可以被认为是可争论的角落性案例,而不是真正的关键分歧,因为"-"的用法取决于作者风格和意图的务实意图.
最后一个例子是,第二位当地人的观点是,虽然这听起来笨拙和不自然,但他们并不认为这不符合语法。
因此,8.75%是严重缺陷实际比率的上限——如果我们删除3个例子,该比率变为5%——因此,俄罗斯的数据质量仍然可以接受。

blocks.en:
Additionally, observe that I G × A I_{\mathrm{G\times A}} will tend to be very small in practice, because it measures shared information between a group and attribute in bits.
In a perfectly unbiased model that assigns equal 0.5 probability to both attributes, knowing any information about the group will lead to no knowledge about the attribute, resulting in a score of 0.
Shifting the model’s bias by a sizable 5% (for a 45-55 bias) will only result in shifting the MI 0.007 bits.
Framing bias in bits is thus better seen as a standardized scale for comparison rather than for individual stereotype analysis.

在完全不带偏见的模型中,将两个属性的概率分配为等同于0.5的概率,知道有关该组的任何信息,将导致对属性一无所知,结果得分为0.

因此,将比特中的分型偏差更好地视为比较的标准尺度,而不是个别定型观念分析的标准尺度。

blocks.en: I.1 Licensing and terms of use
blocks.zh: 一.1 许可证和使用条件

blocks.en:
The original stereotype dataset that we augmented is BiasShades ( Mitchell et al., 2025 ) .
The BiasShades license is found here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LanguageShades/BiasShades/blob/main/LICENSE.md .
In points 3-a-ii and 3-a-iii, it allows the creation and release of data to extend the dataset with additional stereotype samples (subject to the licensors’ authorization).
Once we obtain this authorization we will release our augmented version of BiasShades (including stereotype paraphrases and alternate stereotypes, both LLM-generated) with the same license and access rights as the original BiasShades dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们增加的原始定型观念数据集是Bias Shades(Mitchell等人,2025年)。
BiasShades牌照见此:https://huggingface.co/datasets/LanguageShades/BiasShades/blob/main/LICENSE.md.
在3-a-ii和3-a-iii点中,它允许创建和发布数据,以扩大数据集,并增加陈规定型样本(须经许可人授权)。
一旦获得授权,我们将发布我们的扩展版BiasShades(包括陈词滥调和替代陈词滥调,两者都是LLM生成的),拥有与原BiasShades数据集相同的许可证和访问权.

blocks.en: I.2 Offensive content
blocks.zh: I.2 攻击性内容

blocks.en:
We are augmenting a starting dataset of stereotypes.
As we are generating additional stereotypical data, it is inherently offensive in nature.
However, we generate this content solely to help future efforts on mitigating harm in LLMs.
See Section 8 for our statement on ethical considerations.
blocks.zh:

随着我们产生更多的陈规定型数据,它本质上具有攻击性。
然而,我们编制这些内容只是为了帮助今后努力减轻LLMs中的伤害。
我们关于道德考虑的声明见第8节。
